Tells whether two entities have a clear line of sight between their origins. Every entity with a pick mode that is an obscurer, see [EntityPickMode](EntityPickMode), blocks the view; the two entities themselves and hidden entities never do.

```blitzbasic
Graphics3D 320, 240, 0, 2
SetBuffer BackBuffer()

guard = CreatePivot()
PositionEntity guard, 0, 0, -6
thief = CreatePivot()
PositionEntity thief, 0, 0, 6

crate = CreateCube()
EntityPickMode crate, 2

If EntityVisible(guard, thief)
	Text 8, 8, "The guard sees the thief"
Else
	Text 8, 8, "The crate is in the way"
EndIf
Flip
WaitKey
```

@param src_entity   The entity that looks.
@param dest_entity  The entity it looks at.
@returns True if nothing in the way blocks the line, otherwise False.
